Definition: What proportion of the population does the register cover?
Comments: Birth registration completeness 99.6% per World Bank data from UNICEF surveys.
revision_notes: Both cited sources were fetched and confirmed: World Bank WDI indicator SP.REG.BRTH.ZS (compiled from UNICEF household survey data) reports Algeria's completeness of birth registration at 99.6% for 2019, corroborated by the World Bank Gender Data Portal and CEIC, which cite the identical WDI series. This is the most recent data point in the WDI time series (2006-2019); no fresher figure was found via search. 99.6% falls well within the >89% band, so Value Code 5 is confirmed unchanged.
revised_comments: Birth registration completeness in Algeria stands at 99.6%, based on World Bank/UNICEF household survey data (Demographic and Health Surveys and Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys) for 2019, the most recent year for which this indicator is published. This places population coverage of the civil register in the highest band (>89%).
